meta.title: Text in a numeric sheet cell is rejected, not coerced
warnings: the QA memory is not built, so the plan was written without it — run `npm run rag:build`

plan.title: Reject text in numeric sheet cell

steps.note: Open a standard event create screen with a pricing sheet.
Provide the required event title so the sheet can be configured.
Apply the first available pricing template to render numeric sheet columns.
Add one line item so the pricing sheet has a data row.
Enter non-numeric text in the known numeric Price column and move focus away with Tab.
Assert that the cell does not retain `abc`, does not become zero, and is refused or marked invalid.
Assert that the application shows an error explaining the rejected numeric value.
